title: Launch Espresso — PM daily scratchpad
content:
Quick log / scratchpad for launch preflight. Use this as my single place to capture PRD edits, quick clarifications, and blockers to escalate. Informal — lots of TODOs.

2024-10-28 09:15 — Morning notes
- 30m sync w/ Ben T: infra autoscale thresholds look OK but need canary config tweak.
- Action: add explicit metric for cold-starts in rollout doc (Ben).
- Found a mismatch in PRD: 'burst-capacity' wording — product should call it ‘burst slot’ not capacity. Need copy change.

PRD edits (tracked rough)
- Section: "Rollout and Fallback" (p. 7) — rewrite paragraph to clarify automatic fallback order (hosted -> dedicated -> degrade-mode). Draft: "Fallback attempts compatible model variants in-region; if unavailable, route to dedicated pool or degrade to cached outputs." — put in PRD and ping legal for SLA phrasing.
- API contract: response.status codes — add 429 example and recommended retry-after header guidance. (TODO: add sample curl and SDK snippet)
- Metrics table: add 95th and 99th latencies per model variant; note: data for p99 missing for small-sample models (Mira-7B). Add a note to instrumentation ticket.

Stakeholder follow-ups (who I need to ping)
- @Maya: confirm compliance checklist for private deploy docs — need KMS integration text by Thurs.
- @SRE rotation lead (TBD): confirm runbook steps for cache invalidation during rollout.
- @SalesOps: elevator pitch for Dedicated offering — 3 bullets + pricing. Deadline Fri.

Launch checklist (quick, rough)
- [x] Finish PRD intro + TL;DR (done 10/27)
- [ ] Lock API schema and publish example payloads (blocking: sample response for long streaming)
- [ ] Canary config: set failure threshold = 5% request errors over 5m (Ben to confirm)
- [ ] Alerting: add composite SLO alert for token-rate + p95 latency (SRE)
- [ ] Docs: add troubleshooting section for model misalignment (Maya)
- [ ] Console: per-route burn-rate metric visible in 1 dashboard (product console team)
- [ ] Prepare launch-triage Slack channel and rotation schedule (ops)

Smoke-test notes (manual)
- Quick test plan: create 3 requests: small prompt (<=64), medium (256), long (2048+). Verify: streaming is stable, tokens delivered, no 500 spikes.
- Observed (10/28 manual run): medium prompt sometimes hangs ~1.2s longer when model variant fallback occurs — likely KV cache miss. Add to Ben's ticket.

Unresolved questions / thoughts (note to self)
- Do we allow customers to opt out of automatic fallback? PRD says yes but internal infra not fully implemented. Need product decision: opt-out via account flag or per-request header?
- How aggressive should cache TTL be for shared KV caches? Longer TTL reduces cost but increases stale outputs risk. Add to Optimize sync.
- Should we expose quantization profile names in API response (helpful for reproducibility) or keep them internal? Pros/cons: transparency vs configurability.

Escalations (who to involve if blocked)
- Legal: SLA language for fallback and data retention (urgent if sales uses this week).
- Eng manager (serving runtime): if canary fails twice, escalate to on-call and pause rollout.

Today timeline (rough)
- 09:00 — quick sync w/ Ben (done)
- 10:00 — PRD edit pass (current)
- 11:00 — call w/ Maya re: private-deploy KMS (prepare KMS bullet list)
- 13:00 — lunch + write up API sample responses
- 15:00 — triage with SRE + infra (canary thresholds)
- 16:30 — update launch checklist, send out morning->evening digest to stakeholders

Notes to self / shortcuts
- Use template: "What changed, why, impact" for each PRD edit — helps reviewers.
- When drafting retries guidance, include examples for exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s) and recommend jitter.
- Keep one-line TL;DR at top of PRD for execs.

Random fragments / micro-ideas (brainstorm)
- 'Burst slots' UI: slider + estimated cost delta shown in console (visual).
- Quick-mode: low-cost routing policy that prefers cached outputs and small-model variants for token-budgeted endpoints.

Linked tickets (for follow-up)
- JIRA-PLAT-4567: canary autoscale thresholds (Ben)
- JIRA-PROD-1239: API schema + 429 guidance (me)
- CONFLUENCE-PLAT-921: rollout runbook (drafted, needs SRE signoff)

End-of-day TODOs (carryover)
- Publish updated PRD intro + rollback diagram (me)
- Add sample SDK snippet for retry headers (me)
- Confirm KMS text with Maya + put in Private deploy docs (Maya)

Tiny wins for today
- Reworded fallback paragraph — cleaner, less legal speak.
- Flagged p99 missing metrics before locking PRD table.

If I get stuck:
- Call Ben, screenshare infra logs (helps faster)
- Or drop quick note in #launch-runbook and tag SRE on-call

-- A.K.
